That's not typical Friedel-Crafts acylation (which gives ketone). But maybe it's a variant: acylation of an aniline? Wait product: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1. That's an anilide (aryl amide). The template 2 seems to have Cl-aryl and amide? Actually the retro template: left side (product) is [#7:5]-[C;...]=O attached to aromatic. Right side (precursors) are Cl-aryl and [#7:5]-[CH]=O (i.e., amide? Actually [#7:5]-[CH]=O is formamide? That's an amide? Wait [#7:5]-[CH]=O is a formyl amine? Might be an amide precursor.
